newsitem.title: USA: CME live, feeder cattle futures end mixed.
newsitem.headline: CME live, feeder cattle futures end mixed.

text.p: CME live cattle futures retreated late from early short covering gains to close mixed with funds selling active in October, traders said.

Live cattle ended off 0.100 cent a lb to up 0.225 with only spot August off and October up 0.150 at 68.850 cents. Feeder cattle ended off 0.275 to up 0.150. October closed 0.250 lower at 80.025 cents.

Commercial buying prompted by firmer cash cattle expectations this week offset initial fund selling, but prices drifted back late as follow-through demand was lacking. Late fund selling also pared advances in back months, traders said.
Packers showed increased interest for fed cattle which prompted ideas of possible $66 sales this week.
Concern over possible E.coli in some frozen hamburger patties also dissipated somewhat, they said.
But concern developed over deliveries which weighed on August and back months eased on continued pressure from Friday's bearish Cattle-on-Feed report, they said.
